purpose: Stop a live camera session whose usable video time has not changed for five seconds, clear stale results and permit explicit restart.

contract.progress: Per-session constant-size state observes current video time and usable metadata before capture/result backpressure. Stop at the next visible animation step after 5000ms without observed time change or usable frames. Changed time, including a timeline reset, counts as progress. Stationary image content is not compared.
contract.ownership: Use existing source/session cleanup and a specific restart hint. Late results cannot revive a stalled session or alter replacement state. A new camera start owns a new progress clock; there is no automatic permission request or restart.
contract.verification: Reproduce retained stale presentation on the parent for a paused but live actual browser stream, with and without a held real worker result. Validate clock admission, exact deadline, readiness, timeline reset, clean restart and a live advancing source while a result is held. Retain real WASM/model, timing, presets, geometry and CSP controls. No physical freeze or exposure-clock qualification.
contract.preservation: Preserve scientific JSON, frozen native binaries, prior camera outputs, resolved Cargo.lock and release WASM. No Rust/native/core/GPU changes, compiler runs, sensor acquisition or new SDK/model acquisition.

resources.strategy: Hard-link existing hash-identical vendor files into a fresh E: site. Reuse the release WASM, matching bindgen and installed browser/runtime; keep all evidence and failures.
resources.asset_download_scope: Zero covers local SDK/model acquisition. After publication bounded HTTPS checks may stream up to 32MiB without persisting vendor payloads.

remaining_80_percent: Measured canonical calibration/timing and independent motion, full-room accuracy, qualifying Linux hardware and integrated acceptance remain open.
